DORMANT/ABSENT: a settlement with no _userEdits, and one with _userEdits {}, are both returned REFERENTIALLY unchanged (===) and NO dmLayer key is created — absence stays absence.

⛔ THE FIXPOINT: the second run is byte-identical to the first and the third to the second; a field already owned in dmLayer keeps its ORIGINAL value and is never overwritten by a later _userEdits record (the add-only rule).

COUNTERFORCE / MALFORMED: null, undefined, a string, a number, a non-object _userEdits value and a record missing originalValue — nothing throws, the four non-objects come back ===, and the two malformed records appear in unfoldable and never in dmLayer.

⛔ THE --check ARM WITH THE ROOT/DERIVED CLASSIFIER AND THE NOTES FOLD: auditInlineEditFold over a mixed settlement (two root-foldable, one already owned, one malformed, one DERIVED such as economicViability.summary, one HISTORY such as history.founding.reason) returns all five ASCII-ascending lists — wouldAdd, alreadyOwned, unfoldable, wouldNote; the derived and history edits appear ONLY in wouldNote and land in dmLayer.notes, never in dmLayer.roots; three calls return equal lists; and the settlement is byte-identical before and after.
